Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with Universalis and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Changelog:
### 0.5.0.3 (testing)

- Added a specific-item search and picker in Sniper. All marketable items remains the default. Select an item before Start watching to scan only its history and watch new HQ/NQ listings for that item in the selected market scope. Choose All marketable items to return to the full scan.
